notes.detail: The toggle names an application action. It never writes SharedPreferences or ThemeMode State itself.
Current ThemeMode.kt names this Control.Select(Parameter.Mode). The older 'Debug Menu / Theme Mode' Origin-walk board still labels it Control.Toggle.
Semantic State may already be Dark while persistence is still only requested. Accepting intention does not claim Store success.
This === currentness fence is earned by ThemeMode. It is not a universal token pattern for other Families.
Chronology observes facts as owners learn them. Removing the logger changes no behavior.
AppShell defines these routes once. AppFrame shows them on every PRIMARY screen, so the Screen map draws one route group instead of copying it under Home, Events and Settings.
Clearing has no State-dependent meaning today. A Family would earn its place only if clear needed confirmation, undo, or reuse by another Control.
Debug Menu composes developer controls to rightful owners. It does not own Events, ThemeMode or log semantics.
